subject.title: fix(skills): pass ownerHandle in ClawHub bulk verdict targets to resolve ambiguous slugs

question: Should ambiguous owner-qualified verdicts be resolved by extending ClawHub's bulk contract, or by adding a bounded OpenClaw single-verify fallback?
rationale: The current bulk endpoint ignores the proposed identity field, while the original merged design intentionally rejected per-skill fallback requests; choosing the permanent owner boundary requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Extend the bulk contract
options.body: Update and deploy ClawHub to accept `ownerHandle` per bulk item, then validate this OpenClaw client change end to end.

options.title: Approve a bounded fallback
options.body: Keep bulk lookup primary but explicitly allow owner-qualified single verification after an ambiguous or not-found bulk result when trusted owner metadata exists.

recommendation.title: Extend the bulk contract
recommendation.body: Update and deploy ClawHub to accept `ownerHandle` per bulk item, then validate this OpenClaw client change end to end.

likelyOwner.reason: Introduced the existing bulk-verdict integration and documented its no-per-skill-fallback boundary.
